correctness.rationale: A circle centered at x on side AB has six distinct intersections iff every open edge is cut twice. Strict interior perpendicular foot and endpoint-radius bounds on AC, BC reduce precisely to ell<x<u, and no endpoint qualifies; angles nonacute block projection. The angle-bisector x0=cb/(a+b) witnesses nonemptiness for each eligible side. For the 3–4–5 right triangle independent exact substitution gives ell=15/8, u=25/9, side interval=65/72 and normalized 65/864. Degenerate acute family and equilateral calibration follow by limits. No universal extremum claimed.
